name: Miyoko
source: A "veteran" ghost who has lived for several hundred years. For some reason, she adds English to her speech, and is surprisingly optimistic for a ghost. Miyoko is also pretty mischievious: she often scares people by lifting things up when she is transparent, or showing her figure at night to passersby.
